description: This file defines an interface class IAVBufferHelper for memory management operations related to AV buffers, including mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, and secure data handling. It provides method declarations for buffer manipulation and a factory function for obtaining an implementation instance.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An interface class for handling AV buffer memory operations, including mapping, unmapping, and secure data transfer.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Map memory associated with a handle and return a pointer to it, along with its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmap the memory associated with a handle.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieve the size of the memory allocated for a handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Write data into a secure buffer identified by a handle.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copy data between secure buffers with specified offset and size mappings.

methods.name: getAVBufferHelperInstance
methods.description: Factory function to obtain an instance of IAVBufferHelper.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
